reviews.text: I'm loving this lip tint! The pigmentation and texture feels really premium, I love the way it settles on my lips and actually leaves a stain so that even after eating or drinking I know there is going to be colour left. I love the mini size for travel but definitely planning on purchasing the full size.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支唇釉！顯色度同質地感覺好高級，我鍾意佢喺唇上定色嘅感覺，而且真係會留到染唇效果，咁就算食嘢或者飲嘢之後，我都知仲會有顏色keep住。旅行用迷你裝好方便，但實牙實齒打算入手正裝。

reviews.text: As always, laka is on top when it comes to lip products. The shade range is unmatched! There is something for everyone. I love that they have a mini version because i do like trying lip tints before I commit to the full sized product. The formula is comfortable and thin, but the color payoff is great. Totally recommend and I think it's an essential lip tint for those who like lip products and want something long lasting.
reviews.zh: 一如既往，講到唇部產品，laka 永遠係首選。色號範圍無人能及！總有一款啱你。我鍾意佢哋有迷你裝，因為我鍾意買唇釉之前先試吓。質感舒適又輕薄，但顯色度好出色。完全推薦，我覺得對鍾意唇部產品、又想搵持久唇釉嘅人嚟講，係必買之選。

reviews.text: Beautiful colour upon application, but the tint it leaves is pure orange. The colour applied doesn't reflect in the tint. Im glad I bought the mini to try/will go through quicker. It might be different for others as I have fairly pigmented lips. Otherwise, the product itself besides the colour, is very long lasting and worth trying :)
reviews.zh: 上唇嗰陣色好靚，但留到嘅染唇色係純橙色。上唇時嘅顏色同最後留到嘅染唇色對唔上。好慶幸自己買咗迷你裝先試／會快啲用完。可能喺其他人唇上會唔同，因為我唇色本身都幾深。除此之外，除咗顏色呢點，產品本身係非常持久，值得一試 :)

reviews.text: At first, I was a bit worried because the color looked quite dark when I received it. But once applied on the lips, it looks very natural and gives a healthy, flattering glow. I really like buying mini lip products because I can try many different shades, and they're also super convenient to carry when going out. I'll definitely keep trying other colors!
reviews.zh: 起初我有啲擔心，因為收到嗰陣覺得顏色睇落好深。但搽上唇之後，好自然，俾人一種健康又討好嘅光澤感。我好鍾意買迷你裝唇部產品，可以試多幾隻色號，帶出街亦都好方便。一定會繼續試其他色！

reviews.text:
I love this color!! It's a gothic girl winter with this shade lol
It reminds me of Clinique Black Honey tinted lip balm (the one Liv Tyler wore in LOTR), just a bit more cool tones, around the same shade and sheerness though. It's really pretty and lasts a long time, also smells amazing!!
reviews.zh:
我超鍾意呢個色!!搽咗即刻有種 gothic girl 過冬嘅 feel lol
令我想起 Clinique Black Honey tinted lip balm（就係 Liv Tyler 喺《魔戒》戴嗰隻），只係冷調多咗少少，色號同通透感都差唔多。真的好靚，仲非常持久，氣味都好好聞!!

reviews.text: The formula is probably my favourite lip tint formula to use. It's not drying on the lips and is glowy without feeling oily. 148 Acai shows up as a medium cool toned purple on me but shows up more pink on camera in my experience.
reviews.zh: 我嘅唇釉入面，呢款質地應該係我最鍾意用嘅一款。唔會令嘴唇覺得乾，亦都有水光感但唔會油笠笠。148 Acai 喺我唇上呈現中等冷調紫色，但根據我嘅經驗，相機影出嚟會偏粉紅啲。

reviews.text: I love the mini size to keep in my pouch. From top to bottom: 133 Summer, 137 Breeze, 111 Mellow, 113 Pleasure. Summer looks less bright on the lips once the tint starts to set.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意迷你裝，可以放喺我個小袋入面。由上到下：133 Summer、137 Breeze、111 Mellow、113 Pleasure。Summer 喺唇上定色之後就冇咁鮮明。

reviews.text: ash nut is such a unique color for a lip tint! i don’t think i own any other like it. like it’s name implies, it’s an ashy brown color. it’ll go on looking a little milky or creamy, but will warm up on the lips and become glossy! the scent (and taste 😅) is fruity, but not overbearing. it’s very comfortable on the lips, but not super long lasting (which i never expect from glossy tints anyway).
reviews.zh: ash nut 真係唇釉入面好獨特嘅顏色！我諗唔到自己有第二隻類似嘅色。如佢個名所指，就係帶灰調嘅啡色。剛搽上去會有少許奶白或者 creamy 嘅感覺，但喺唇上會暖化並變得有光澤！氣味（仲有味道 😅）係水果味，但唔算overbearing。搽喺唇上好舒服，但唔算超級持久（不過我從來都唔期望 glossy 唇釉會好持久啦）。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
